summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology building real-time edge AI systems that run on NVIDIA Jetson-class hardware. I deploy and optimize perception models with TensorRT and CUDA, integrate cameras and sensors at the hardware-software boundary, and debug issues across embedded Linux, power, and peripheral integration. Comfortable moving between Python, C++, and hands-on hardware work to bring up and validate new edge devices.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Built a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with a Raspberry Pi over I2C and HC-05 Bluetooth for hands-free cursor control.
Eliminated sensor jitter through a custom z-axis thresholding algorithm, software calibration, and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; wired sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.
Led a 25-member robotics team across national competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images to 83% mAP@50; exported to ONNX and TFLite for on-device edge deployment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — M.S. Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place robot across a distributed edge pipeline: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and NVIDIA Jetson perception.
Deployed TensorRT-optimized YOLO on Jetson for a 5.2× inference speedup, alongside faster-whisper STT and a multi-camera frame capture pipeline.
Debugged 11 hardware-software integration failures (servo brown-out, stale-frame capture, false-positive detections); reached 100% pick reliability at ~11.5s cycle time.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Ran YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, streaming commands to a microcontroller over UART with interrupt-driven multi-servo PWM and a VL53L0X ToF sensor.

projects.name: SLM Compression & Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Cut GPU memory footprint ~55% via 8-bit quantization (LLM.int8) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and latency under edge constraints with <1% accuracy loss.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced VGG16 TorchScript conv layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory; ~35% speedup over naive GPU at identical accuracy.
